author: Fabien Motte
subject: feat(build): unify build system across monorepo (#6886)
body:
* chore: upgrade rollup dependency and use it for all packages

* chore: migrate from Parcel to Vite for examples

* chore(codemods): migrate from Parcel to Rollup build

* chore(instantsearch.js): migrate all builds to Rollup

* chore(examples): migrate React SSR example from Webpack to Vite

* chore: remove obsolete babel preset and clean up yarn.lock

* chore: add shared Rollup configuration utilities

* chore: add Codacy config to exclude Rollup configs

* chore(vue-instantsearch): fix aliasVueCompat plugin to correctly resolve vue-compat imports

* chore(vue-instantsearch): use shared Rollup plugin utilities

* chore: migrate build from Babel to SWC

* chore: remove @rollup/rollup-darwin-arm64 dependency

* chore(build): disable SWC external helpers

* chore: improve extension resolver for ESM builds

* chore: enable SWC external helpers

* chore: preserve modules root for ESM output

* chore(vue-instantsearch): mark @swc/helpers as external

* chore: fix plugin order and commonjs handling

* chore: support Storybook-specific Babel settings

* chore: add `babel-preset-vue` dependency

* chore(vue-instantsearch): scope Storybook babel-loader to algoliasearch

* chore: add legacy file name option for UMD bundles

* chore: update bundle size limits after build optimization

* chore: update bundle size limits

* chore: add CJS version of extension resolver plugin and add tests

* chore: add plugin to wrap warnings with __DEV__ checks

* chore: fix SWC JSX pragma collision with local vars

* chore: pin baseline-browser-mapping to 2.9.19 to avoid warning

* chore: fix examples

* chore: share JSX pragma fix plugins across builds

* chore: update bundle size limit

* chore: exclude UMD example packages from TypeScript

* chore: exclude example symlinks from linting and type checking

* cleanup dependencies

* output comparison

* chore(build): preserve module structure and use all source entries as input

- Enable preserveModules for react-instantsearch, react-instantsearch-core,
  and instantsearch-ui-components to match the old Babel file-by-file output.
  This fixes module identity issues where root imports and deep path imports
  would resolve to different module instances.
- Use collectSourceEntries() to walk all source files as rollup inputs
  (instead of just index.ts), ensuring barrel and type-only files are emitted.
- Disable sourcemaps across all build formats to match npm output.

* chore: update bundle size limit

* chore: update bundle size limit

* bump
